start: Settings, Your data, 'Bring in from Hevy or Strong'; member has a Hevy export .csv on the phone and an empty or own history

steps.action: Pick Hevy, land on 'Import from Hevy'
user_sees: Card 'Bring your Hevy history in' with numbered export steps, 'Kilograms or pounds: both are read.', 'Everything is processed on your phone — nothing is uploaded.'
must_not: The Strong steps shown for Hevy

steps.action: Tap 'Choose Hevy file', pick the export
user_sees: Button reads 'Reading…', then a preview: file name, Workouts, Sets, Exercises, Date range
must_not: The file sent to a server; a preview with 0 workouts for a real export

steps.action: Answer any new-name question, pick Merge, tap the import button
user_sees: Progress while importing, then 'Workouts added', 'Sets logged', 'New exercises created'
must_not: A workout already in MettleUp added a second time (same day, started within 30 minutes)

steps.action: Tap 'See your workouts'
user_sees: The imported workouts in History on their own dates
must_not: Imported workouts missing from History or on a shifted date

start: Import from Hevy, idle screen (Hevy branch only)

steps.action: Tap 'Paste a Hevy link' under 'Have a Hevy routine link?'
user_sees: Screen 'Import routines', 'Copy your routines from Hevy', a link box, 'Read link' (greyed while the box is empty)
must_not: The paste screen offered from the Strong branch

steps.action: Paste a hevy.com/folder/… link, tap 'Read link'
user_sees: 'Reading your Hevy link…', 'This takes a few seconds.', then the check-and-follow steps with every routine ticked
must_not: Routines changed from how they were saved in Hevy (sets, reps, rest)

steps.action: Finish the steps and pick a folder
user_sees: The routines in the chosen folder
must_not: The member's current plan changed without picking it

start: Member shares a Strong .csv from the Files app into MettleUp (or picks it through 'Import from Hevy')

steps.action: Share the file to MettleUp
user_sees: The import screen opens and reads the file once; title becomes 'Import from Strong'
must_not: The file read twice; a Strong file treated as Hevy

steps.action: When the old Strong file does not say its units, pick 'Kilograms and km' or 'Pounds and miles'
user_sees: Each option shows a real set from the file, e.g. 'Bench Press: 100 lb (45.4 kg)'; Import waits ('Choose kg or lb first')
must_not: Import running before units are picked; lb stored as kg

steps.action: Import, then tap 'Bring my routines in'
user_sees: Routines built from the workouts repeated most
must_not: Routines made from one-off workouts only

steps.action: Choose a file that is not a Hevy or Strong export (a photo, a random csv)
user_sees: 'This file isn’t a Hevy or Strong export. In Hevy: Settings → Export & Backup Data. In Strong: Settings → Export Strong Data.'
must_not: A crash, a blank preview, or anything written to History

steps.action: Choose a real export with no workouts
user_sees: 'No workouts were found in that file.'
must_not: An import button that imports nothing and says done

steps.action: On 'Import routines', paste a non-Hevy link and tap 'Read link'
user_sees: 'That isn’t a Hevy share link. It looks like hevy.com/folder/… or hevy.com/routine/…'
must_not: A network read of a non-Hevy address

steps.action: Paste a deleted Hevy link
user_sees: 'Hevy says this link does not exist any more. Copy it again from Hevy.'
must_not: An empty routine list shown as success

start: Preview of an export whose dates are numbers only (can be read two ways)

steps.action: Look at the preview
user_sees: 'This file writes dates as numbers only…', choices day-first and month-first; the import button reads 'Answer the date question first'
must_not: Import allowed before the answer; day and month swapped silently

steps.action: Import fails in the middle (e.g. storage error)
user_sees: 'The import failed. Nothing was changed. Please try again.' and the preview again
must_not: Half the workouts written; the success screen shown

start: Own history of 20 workouts; preview of a Hevy file

steps.action: Pick Replace
user_sees: A confirm 'Delete 20 workouts first?' with how many are not in the file, button 'Replace'
must_not: Workouts deleted with no question

steps.action: Confirm; import finishes
user_sees: Undo bar '20 workouts replaced' and 'Undo import'
must_not: No way back after Replace

steps.action: Tap 'Undo import'
user_sees: 'Import undone', 'Everything is back as it was before the import.'
must_not: Imported workouts left behind, or the 20 old ones still missing

steps.action: Import the same file again with Merge
user_sees: 'Already imported (skipped)' count; Workouts added 0
must_not: Every workout added a second time

start: App still holds the demo (sample) data; member imports a Hevy file

steps.action: Preview shows 'The demo goes first' and a name box 'First and last name'
user_sees: The demo will be removed before import
must_not: Import mixing into demo workouts

steps.action: Leave the name empty, tap import
user_sees: 'Your name, please. The demo’s name goes with the demo.'
must_not: Import running with the demo's name kept

steps.action: Type a name, import
user_sees: Undo bar 'Demo removed, history imported'
must_not: Demo workouts left in History next to imported ones

start: Member imports a Hevy file and a Hevy link

steps.action: Read the idle card
user_sees: 'Everything is processed on your phone — nothing is uploaded.'
must_not: The export file sent to MettleUp or a third party

steps.action: Read a Hevy link
user_sees: Only the public Hevy share page is read
must_not: Member data sent to Hevy with the request

steps.action: Gym owner looks at the member in the gym panel
user_sees: Only what the member already shares (workout dates/summary per their switches)
must_not: Imported exercises, weights or notes shown to the gym
